user.title: Entity Watchdog
user.description: This adds the Entity Watchdog integration. After setup, open “Configure” to add the sensors you want to monitor.

add.title: Add sensor
add.description: Pick the device you want to monitor. On the next step you'll choose which of its entities to watch.

add_entity.title: Add sensor
add_entity.description: Pick the entity that updates on every report (for a Shelly BLU or a Zigbee device, its signal-strength / LQI entity works well).

add_bulk.title: Add multiple devices
add_bulk.description: Pick the integration whose devices you want to monitor, e.g. BTHome.

add_bulk_devices.title: Add multiple devices
add_bulk_devices.description:
All devices of this integration that are not monitored yet are ticked. Untick the ones you don't want. The entity shown in brackets is picked automatically (signal strength first, otherwise temperature or humidity) and can be changed later via “Edit sensor”.

Devices skipped because no suitable entity was found: {skipped}

abort.no_devices: No devices available to add: every device of this integration is already monitored or has no suitable entity (an enabled signal-strength, temperature or humidity sensor).
